mission_phase: Generation 21 - Connected Site to Run to Results UI
phase_goal: Restructure the dashboard around the real hierarchy - a Shopify site has inspection runs, and each run has results/evidence - so the operator navigates Site to Run to Results with the connection always visible (breadcrumbs), instead of a flat list of runs and reports.
reason_generation_started: Operator: each run is tied to a Shopify site and results come from an inspection; the UI should show those connections (evidence for everything) rather than a bunch of runs and reports.
standing_directive: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE (2026-07-15): do NOT trigger inspection runs. Only the operator runs inspections via the UI. Validate using runs already on disk; never spawn a run for testing. Recorded as FND-GEN021-000.

functional: The left panel is site-centric; runs are grouped under their site, not shown as a flat top-level list.
Selecting a site shows the site with its inspection runs; selecting a run shows that run's results with a breadcrumb Site > Run > Results.
Every results view traces back to its site and run via visible breadcrumb navigation.
usability: Interactive holistic walkthrough (as-a-user, no runs triggered): navigate Sites, drill into a site, open a run's results, use breadcrumbs to go back, switch views - all coherent with the sidebar and right pane in sync.
Confirm no inspection is triggered by any navigation action during testing.
technical: validate:dashboard, validate:gen13, validate all green against existing runs on disk; git diff --check clean; no new run-inspection processes spawned during validation.

validation_notes: VAL-069 two clean passes: validate:dashboard (now asserting site-nav/run-card/renderSiteView/crumbSite), validate:gen13, validate all green; pass 2 after commit a936b2a with no implementation changes.

Holistic UI walkthrough: site-centric sidebar, per-site runs, run results with breadcrumb, and cross-site navigation all coherent; Datasets and Settings keep the sites list correctly hidden; no dead clicks.
No inspection run was triggered during validation (FND-GEN021-000 honored) — validated entirely against runs already on disk.
BDD inventory refreshed to BDD-INV-010 (55 BDDs, 3 new for GEN-021, 53 passing, 2 deferred).
known_gaps_opened: Site cards surface run status per run but do not yet summarize per-site health (last-clean date, open findings count) at the site level.
The dashboard validator still hard-depends on a Ridge run existing on disk (carried from GEN-020); cleaning all runs would break it until one is restored.
